subject: Shotclock request: late-binding dependencies on due-diligence items
thread_text:
From: Alyssa Nguyen <alyssa@nimbuscloud.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: procurement@acme-corp.com
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP health check — due diligence dependencies pushing close

Marcus —

Quick note from my side: legal and our security team flagged a couple of outstanding items in your security checklist and they said they won't sign off until we have the SOC-2 evidence plus a short description of key management. That pushes our internal gating for contract execution. Procurement is asking whether you can confirm a firm close date by EOD today; without that they may re-open the vendor slate.

I've attached our annotated MAP. We still want Redwood, but we need explicit remediation commitments for:
- SOC-2 report availability window (or equivalent attestation)
- KMS integration approach (cloud vs customer-managed)
- Data retention & deletion flow for dev logs

Can you confirm a revised timeline and whether Redwood can commit to a short stopgap (temporary attestation + follow-up window) so we don't lose momentum?

Thanks,
Alyssa
Alyssa Nguyen
Head of Cloud Partnerships — Nimbus Cloud
--- attachment: Nimbus_MAP_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet) ---

----------
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com>
To: Alyssa Nguyen <alyssa@nimbuscloud.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.inference.com>, procurement@acme-corp.com
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP health check — due diligence dependencies pushing close

Alyssa — thanks for the heads up and for the annotated MAP. Appreciate the transparency. Quick summary of where we are and a proposed shotclock to prevent slate re-open: 

Status summary (short):
- SOC-2: Redwood is in progress on a scoped SOC-2 Type II engagement; we can provide our most recent SOC readiness report and the auditor engagement letter by EOD tomorrow. Final Type II report ETA: 2027-08-30 (we can negotiate a contractual attestation in the meantime).
- KMS: We support both Redwood-managed keys (default) and customer-managed keys via AWS KMS/GCP KMS. We will provide a one-page integration summary and a PoC checklist by 2027-07-16.
- Retention: We will deliver a documented retention & deletion flow (including dev-log exclusions) by 2027-07-16 and commit to a 90-day deletion SLA for dev logs in the production contract.

Proposed shotclock (to lock current commitments and avoid re-slate):
1) By 2027-07-16 17:00 PDT — Redwood provides the readiness evidence set (readiness report, KMS one-pager, retention doc).
2) Nimbus legal reviews and confirms whether the evidence is sufficient for a conditional signature by 2027-07-19.
3) If conditional signature accepted, Redwood will include a contractual remediation schedule in the SOW with milestones to produce SOC-2 Type II by 2027-08-30.

I propose we set the close target to 2027-07-23 for signature execution if the conditional sign-off route is acceptable. If we don't get conditional acceptance by 07/19, we should reconvene with procurement to discuss the next steps.

I'll loop in Laura and Ben internally to confirm we can meet the 07/16 deliverables.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
--- attachment: SOW_draft_v3.pdf (pdf) ---

----------
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 10:47:00 -0700
Subject: RE: MAP health check — due diligence dependencies pushing close (internal)

+1 on commitments. Operational notes:
- Security can push a readiness report by 07/16 but won't provide a formal SOC-2 until the Type II completes. We can share the auditor letter and latest gap remediation tracker instead.
- Priyom: can you confirm the KMS one-pager and the PoC checklist cadence? We should include a line item in SOW_draft_v3 for a 2-week PoC window with a rollback decision gate.
- Ben: procurement discounts/credits — we need a fallback credit if timeline slips beyond 07/30. Can you draft a short approval note so I can sign off?

I'll prep a redlined SOW paragraph that captures the conditional signature workflow and remediation milestone table.

Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Sales Ops — Redwood Inference

----------
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 11:12:00 -0700
Subject: RE: MAP health check — due diligence dependencies pushing close (internal)

I can approve a one-time onboarding credit if we get a signed conditional contract by 07/23. Suggestion: 10% first-year credit tied to acceptance criteria in the MAP (SOC attestation window and PoC completion). I'll put a short approval note in Ops.

Ben
Ben Carter
VP, Sales — Redwood Inference

----------
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com>
To: Alyssa Nguyen <alyssa@nimbuscloud.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.inference.com>, procurement@acme-corp.com
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2027 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP health check — due diligence dependencies pushing close

Alyssa — quick follow up with the shotclock and concrete deliverables attached. We are prepared to accept a conditional signature approach. To reiterate:

Deliverables (by 2027-07-16 17:00 PDT):
- Auditor engagement letter + readiness report (security) — security-checklist-snapshot.csv attached.
- KMS integration one-pager + PoC checklist (Priyom) — included in Drive link.
- Retention & deletion flow doc (legal) — included in SOW_draft_v3.pdf.

If Nimbus agrees to conditional sign-off by 2027-07-19, Redwood will insert milestones into SOW_draft_v3 and commit to producing SOC-2 Type II by 2027-08-30. Ben has pre-approved a limited onboarding credit tied to the milestone schedule.

Please confirm whether the conditional sign-off is acceptable so procurement can proceed. If you'd like, I can schedule a 30-minute triage call tomorrow at 10:00 PDT to walk through the artifacts.

Thanks,
Marcus
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
